title: Rabbi Tanchum bar Chakhinai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Shevuot 36a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shevuot.36a.29). But the statement is cited in [Kiddushin 62a](https://www.sefaria.org/Kiddushin.62a.2) and [Sotah 17a](https://www.sefaria.org/Sotah.17a.14), and there it reads Rabbi Tanchum without further designation, as Hyman also reports for Dikdukei Soferim. He cites [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3576&lang=en) for Rabbi Tanchum bar Chanilai.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The consulted Shevuot 36a names Rabbi Tanchum bar Chakhinai; Kiddushin 62a and Sotah 17a have Rabbi Tanchum without a patronymic. Hyman's reports of Dikdukei Soferim and the Seder HaDorot reading bar Chanilai were not directly collated. The parallel saying does not independently prove an identity between these forms.
Heilprin files the notice under Tanchum bar Chanilai, but quotes Tanchum bar Chakhinai when he cites Shevuot. The heading and the name in his quotation differ.
